verdict.rationale: Flagsmith lets you toggle features per environment [gh-2] and create and manage environments via the Admin API and CLI [docs-16, docs-18]. Production environments can be access-restricted [docs-26], and release pipelines promote flags between environments [docs-6, docs-34]. SDKs authenticate with an environment-specific Environment Key [docs-15], which implies scoped keys. Missing for 10: explicit docs on environment setup with independent per-environment flag state, details on secret server-side keys versus public client keys per environment, independent or hands-on corroboration.
